name: scientific-slides
title_zh: 答辩前夜把PPT从60页砍到18页的学术排版师
tagline_zh: 给科研汇报做PPT，不是套模板。它先帮你理结构、定节奏，再逐页查视觉硬伤——图表是否清晰、文字是否超载。
tagline_en: For research talks, not template-filling. It structures your story, paces timing, then audits each slide for.
desc_en: Build slide decks and presentations for research talks. Use this for making PowerPoint slides, conference presentations, seminar talks, research presentations, thesis defense slides, or any scientific talk. Provides slide structure, design templates, timing guidance, and visual validation. Works with PowerPoint and LaTeX Beamer.
why_zh: 它把演讲当论证来设计：先定每页唯一论点，再配图与过渡。内置视觉校验，能抓出字号、对比度。
why_en: Treats slides as arguments: one claim per slide, then visuals and transitions. Built-in visual checks catch specific issues—font.
limit_zh: 只认学术汇报场景（会议、研讨、答辩），不适用于教学课件或商业提案。仅输出PPT或Beamer源文件，不含演讲逐字稿。
limit_en: Only for academic talks (conference, seminar, defense), not teaching or business decks. Outputs PPT/Beamer source only, no speaker script. Visual.
title_en: Academic slide editor that trims 60 slides to 18 before.
